title: Senior Human Resource Executive
description:
1. Position Details Position: Senior HR Executive Experience: Minimum 5+ years Salary Range: 40,000. - 50,000 per month, depending on the candidate's experience and suitability Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat Industry Preference: Pharmaceutical experience preferred Department: Human Resources 
 2. Key Responsibilities A. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Manage the complete recruitment cycle, from manpower requisition to candidate onboarding. Understand departmental requirements and prepare effective sourcing strategies. Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, databases, and recruitment consultants. Screen resumes, conduct initial telephonic interviews, and evaluate candidates against job requirements. Coordinate interview schedules with department heads and management. Manage candidate follow-ups, salary negotiations, offer releases, and joining confirmations. Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and recruitment MIS. Monitor recruitment TAT, offer-to-joining ratio, and vacancy closure progress. B. Payroll & Salary Administration Independently manage monthly payroll processing and salary calculations. Verify attendance, leave records, overtime, late marks, and salary-related adjustments. Prepare and verify payroll inputs, salary sheets, and employee-wise salary calculations. Understand salary structures, CTC calculations, gross salary, net salary, and statutory deductions. Have working knowledge of PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, TDS on salary, and other applicable statutory requirements. Coordinate with the accounts team for salary disbursement and payroll reconciliation. Handle full and final settlements, salary revisions, arrears, and exit-related payroll calculations. Maintain payroll records and ensure confidentiality of employee compensation data. C. KRA, KPI & Performance Management Prepare and update employee-wise Key Result Areas (KRAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Define measurable performance parameters, targets, weightages, and scoring criteria for different departments and designations. Prepare monthly and quarterly employee KPI reports based on actual achievements against defined targets. Analyse employee performance and prepare performance summaries and MIS reports. Coordinate with department heads to review employee performance and collect performance data. Support performance appraisal processes, increment recommendations, and performance improvement plans. Ensure KRAs and KPIs are aligned with departmental objectives and organisational goals. D. Job Description (JD) Preparation Prepare detailed and structured job descriptions for different positions across departments. Coordinate with department heads to understand job requirements, responsibilities, qualifications, experience, and technical skills. Define reporting structures, key responsibilities, required competencies, and performance expectations. Update JDs whenever there are changes in roles or responsibilities. Ensure JDs are aligned with recruitment requirements and employee performance evaluation criteria. E. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Management Manage joining formalities, employee documentation, induction, onboarding, and employee records. Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, employment agreements, confirmation letters, increment letters, and other HR documents. Maintain employee master data, personal files, attendance records, leave records, and probation trackers. Monitor probation periods and coordinate employee confirmation reviews. Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, employee engagement, and retention initiatives. Manage exit formalities, clearance processes, full and final settlements, and exit interviews. Ensure HR policies are communicated effectively and implemented consistently. F. HR Compliance & MIS Maintain HR documentation and records in accordance with applicable company policies and statutory requirements. Monitor compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory employment obligations. Prepare monthly HR MIS reports covering recruitment, payroll, attendance, attrition, headcount, and other HR metrics. Maintain trackers, dashboards, and reports to support management decision-making. Ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and timely completion of all HR activities. 
 3. Mandatory Skills & Knowledge The candidate must have strong practical knowledge and hands-on experience in the following three core areas : Payroll Management: End-to-end payroll processing, salary structures, attendance inputs, statutory deductions, payroll reconciliation, and full and final settlements. KRA, KPI & JD Preparation: Independently drafting JDs, developing measurable KRAs and KPIs, assigning weightages, evaluating performance, and preparing performance reports. Recruitment: End-to-end recruitment, candidate sourcing, resume screening, interview coordination, salary negotiation, offer management, and vacancy closure. In addition to the above, the candidate should possess: Strong knowledge of HR operations and employee lifecycle management. Practical understanding of applicable labour laws and statutory HR compliance. Good command of MS Excel, including formulas, lookup functions, PivotTables, data validation, and HR reporting. Experience in maintaining employee databases, payroll sheets, recruitment trackers, and KPI reports. Strong communication, coordination, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Good analytical ability, attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and time management. Ability to work independently, manage multiple HR responsibilities, and meet deadlines. High standards of confidentiality, integrity, accountability, and professional conduct. 
 4. Preferred Candidate Profile Candidates with prior experience in the pharmaceutical industry will be preferred .  Candidates currently residing in Ahmedabad or nearby areas will be given the highest priority. Experience handling HR responsibilities in a small or mid-sized organisation, preferably with multiple departments. Candidates who have independently managed payroll, recruitment, HR documentation, and performance management will be given preference. Candidates with practical experience in preparing KRAs, KPIs, and JDs rather than only theoretical knowledge are strongly preferred. Candidates should be comfortable working in a hands-on HR role and coordinating directly with management and department heads.
